title: Educational Scholarship Scheme, Madhya Pradesh (Labour Welfare Board)
eligibility: Students studying from Class 5 to Class 12 and in higher education, subject to scheme conditions
documents_required: Documents specified in the application notice/official scheme record
application_process: Apply through the relevant regional Labour Welfare Board officer
important_sections_or_clauses: Official record: applications are to be submitted within 30 days of publication inviting applications.
source_type: Official Government of Madhya Pradesh CM Helpline Scheme Dashboard
